{"description":"Goal: implement the activity plugin v1: a privacy-first local activity timeline for the Bitty terminal (counts/durations/cwd aggregates; store_command_args false by default; workspace cannot widen).

Scope: lua/ (entry point + aggregation), bitty-plugin.toml (declared capabilities/lazy triggers only; start from the CTX-0001 scaffold: terminal.semantic-read + platform.notify), tests and docs as needed, CHANGELOG. No high-risk capabilities, no fs.write/network/process, no install scripts, and no argument or terminal-content storage without a reviewed task and privacy note.

Acceptance: manifest round-trips through bitty-plugin-lint; lazy help works without creating a VM; disable reclaims generation resources; --safe parity; privacy notes in README and PR; dogfood signals per PX-1199; docs sync to the bitty-docs canonical corpus; CI plus independent review green.

Dependencies: CTX-0001 complete; bitty-plugin-sdk R-SDK-1 (lua/bitty.d.lua) + R-SDK-3 (mock-host conformance) merged at origin/main 721aea8; bitty-plugin-template R-TPL-1 at origin/main 494c743.
